content: TcpIp_Bind () shall check if there is another socket already bound to the same port, protocol and local address and if that is the case refuse the request and return E_NOT_OK. If development error detection is enabled, the service TcpIp_Bind () shall also raise the development error code TCPIP_E_ADDRINUSE.
